_comment: Grade 3 Unit 1 (We can build it!) already carries Personal contribution (3Fc) but not Teamwork (3Ft, 'Identify how working together improved the shared outcome achieved') — a natural fit for its team-build project. Added 2026-09-17 to close a documented Stage 3 coverage gap, in Rami's own voice with his team Amal, Karim and Nadia.

addExplainers.title: Stronger together
addExplainers.body:
Rami could have tried to build everything by himself. Instead, Amal measured, Karim fixed the pieces together, and Nadia checked that it was steady. Rami painted it at the end.

Think about your own build. Would it have been as good if just one person had done every part alone? What got BETTER because your team worked on it together?

Say one real way that working together improved what your team built.
bullets: Think about the different jobs in your team.
Ask: would it be as good if one person did it all?
Say one way working together made it better.

addObjectives.evidence: the Activity Sheet's new 'Stronger together' page: "What got BETTER because your team worked on it together? ... Say one real way that working together improved what your team built." — identifies how working together improved the shared outcome
